attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), installed busybox-extras to get an httpd applet, populated /srv/localrepo/x86_64 with tree-2.2.1-r0.apk (fetched with deps) and an apk index, then served it via `busybox-extras httpd -p 8080`. Simulated remote-repo unreachability by mapping dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org to 127.0.0.1 in /etc/hosts (confirmed apk update failed with Connection refused against both remote repos), then successfully installed `tree` via `apk add --repository http://10.100.52.10:8080 --allow-untrusted tree` while remote was unreachable. Reverted /etc/hosts and confirmed remote reachability restored. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and running local repo/httpd state, rebooted node1 natively, polled until it came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified tree remained installed and the local repo/httpd could be brought back up and served correctly (HTTP 200) after restart.
